notes: §1985:X.5.2.3 SR3: each USING operand is a data item of the File, Working-Storage, Communication or Linkage Section and "must be a level 01 data item, a level 77 data item, or an elementary data item". The section half is CallBinder#ScreenCallOperand via ParameterConformance#ScreenSection (StorageSectionRule.Cobol85). The level half is VersionConformancePass#GateStatement's call-using-group-any-level-2002 row, which asks Place.DenotesGroupItem and the level of Place.DenotedItem (kb/Work PB5383): a reference-modified operand is elementary (§1985:IV.4.3.8.4.4 GR5), accepted; a level-66 RENAMES ... THRU item is a group item (§1985:VI.5.11.4 GR1) at level 66, refused COBOL0900 (cases 1985-SR-X_5_2_3-3-refmod and 1985-SR-X_5_2_3-3-renames).

next.reason: 1985: "Communication Section, or Linkage Section, and must be a level 01 data item, a level 77 data item, or an elementary data item"; 2023: "Identifier-2 shall reference an address-identifier or a data item defined in the file, working-storage, local-storage, or linkage section.". 2023 drops the level 01/77/elementary limit, so subordinate group items are allowed. Communication Section is gone; local-storage and address-identifiers are added.
